text:
Predicates:
LocatedIn(x, y) ::: x is located in y.

Premises:
Beijing is the capital of the People's Republic of China. ::: (No predicate needed, factual statement)
Beijing is the world's most populous national capital city. ::: (No predicate needed, factual statement)
Beijing is located in Northern China. ::: LocatedIn(Beijing, NorthernChina)

Conclusion:
LocatedIn(Beijing, SouthernChina)
